How It WorksAboutPrivacy

Real lineups. Real results.

Sunday Split is a free, independent football game built around a familiar league-chat argument: which of these lineups actually won?

Five completed fantasy matchups make up the daily game. You compare the starters, make your calls, then see how the points landed. There are no entry fees or cash prizes.

Where the data comes from

Matchups, starters, fantasy points, and league scoring come from publicly accessible Sleeper API league endpoints. The published pool includes completed 2026 matchups and a 2025 archive, drawn from ten-team leagues with conventional one-quarterback starting lineups.

The import process excludes ties, incomplete lineups, commissioner-adjusted scores, unsupported formats, and totals that do not match the starters' points. Each revealed matchup links to its source. Published pools are snapshots refreshed periodically, not a live feed of every Sleeper league.

Recent form and opponents

Historical weekly stats and schedule information from Sleeper supply opponent and prior-game clues. A player's average uses up to three earlier NFL regular-season appearances under the matchup's league scoring. Byes and missed games are skipped; played games with zero points count. The hidden matchup is never included.

Form graphs compare earlier performances with each other. They are not forecasts. Missing or incomplete history is labeled, and some custom scoring formats do not have recent-form clues.

Player images and team marks

Player headshots and team logos are served from Sleeper-hosted image URLs. All player and team names, images, logos, and other marks belong to their respective owners. Their appearance identifies real players and teams; it does not imply an endorsement or a grant of commercial rights.

How the daily set is chosen

Daily sets are date-seeded, balancing close and competitive finishes with other matchups. Selection checks both lineups to avoid repeating a player's performance from the same season and week, and aims to spread rounds across weeks. Sparse pools may require a fallback. Already saved daily sets are kept intact.

The same player can appear in different weeks. A historical surprise is not proof of a betting upset: the game does not claim to have reconstructed pregame odds.

Shared play, honestly

Community tallies come from actual submitted browser-profile picks. We do not seed fake votes or claim those profiles represent verified unique people. League scores are calculated from frozen matchup totals, but answers are also delivered to the browser so this is a casual fan game, not an anti-cheat system.

Independent and fan-made

Sunday Split is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the National Football League, its teams, the NFL Players Association, or Sleeper.

Feedback and contact

Found a wrong score, a broken image, or something that could be better? Open an issue on GitHub. Include the mode, season, week, and what went wrong. Issues are public: do not post passwords, private contact information, or a challenge link you want to keep private.
